case.title: Pump housing PH-100: the foundry wants +8.8 %
case.briefing: Demo Gießerei GmbH, our single source for the grey-iron pump housing PH-100 for 12 years, announces +8.8 % from 1 December citing energy and wages. Castings are a strategic category: the goal is to stabilise supply with a healthy partner, so squeezing the foundry below a 4 % margin costs us (from EUR 5,000 per margin point and year). We need 4,000 housings a year for the next two years; anything not covered by this deal costs EUR 55.00 per unit (spot buys and a second source). Price, payment terms, contract length and the date the new price applies are open; lead time and Incoterm are fixed.

sup:DEMO-F1.subject: Quote from Demo Gießerei GmbH: Pump housing PH-100: the foundry wants +8.8 %
sup:DEMO-F1.body:
Guten Tag,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

It is always a pleasure to work with your esteemed house, continuing the strong tradition of craftsmanship and trust between our companies. For this agreement, our offer stands at a price of €52.90 per unit, a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, valid from 1 December 2026. 

To remain transparent about our situation, WAGES-METAL rose 3.1 % in twelve months and is 28 % of our cost. We take great pride in the dedication of our foundry workforce and the quality we deliver to our partners every day.

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days. We look forward to continuing our successful cooperation together.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

message.subject: Re: Quote from Demo Gießerei GmbH: Pump housing PH-100: the foundry wants +8.8 %
message.body:
Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We thank you for your prompt response and the alternative proposals. 

In the spirit of our long-standing partnership, we are willing to accept the 24-month contract and the 60-day payment term you requested. However, the prices you suggested do not reflect our current realities, so we can offer €51.60 per unit for these extended terms. 

Our current Angebot stands at a price of €51.60 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 December 2026. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days. 

Our family foundry takes great pride in our deep roots and our enduring connection with Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH. It is always a pleasure to craft solutions together, and we trust this adjusted path serves us both well.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

message.subject: Re: Quote from Demo Gießerei GmbH: Pump housing PH-100: the foundry wants +8.8 %
message.body:
Guten Tag,

It is always a pleasure to build upon the long, trusted relationship between our companies, and our foundry takes great pride in delivering the highest quality for Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH. 

In response to your movement, we are prepared to reduce our price to €51.10 for the 45-day payment term. This alternative package offers a price of €51.10 per unit, Zahlungsziel 45 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 December 2026.

Otherwise, our main offer stands at a price of €51.30 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 December 2026. This offer remains valid for 7 days.

This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. We are making every effort to reach an agreement, but we need to see more substantial steps from your side to close the gap.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH
